reference_sql:
WITH checks AS (
  -- one row per check: sessions from every session_start event, consent-denied ones included
  SELECT 'sessions' AS check_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130') AS export_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', session_start), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130') AS backend_count
  UNION ALL
  -- sign-ups: every sign_up event against signups by the Dublin day of signup_ts
  SELECT 'sign-ups',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'sign_up' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signups WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130')
  UNION ALL
  -- purchases: every purchase event against first payments, refunded ones included
  SELECT 'purchases',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (/* one row per subscription: its first payment */ SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) AS f
      WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130')
)
SELECT check_name, export_count, backend_count,
  CASE WHEN export_count = backend_count THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM checks

WITH export_counts AS (
  -- one row per check: the export's count of one event name over the Dublin days of November 2025
  SELECT CASE event_name WHEN 'session_start' THEN 'sessions' WHEN 'sign_up' THEN 'sign-ups' ELSE 'purchases' END AS check_name,
    COUNT(*) AS export_count
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('session_start', 'sign_up', 'purchase')
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  GROUP BY event_name
), backend_counts AS (
  -- one row per check: the backend's count on the same Dublin days
  SELECT 'sessions' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS backend_count
  FROM sessions
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', session_start), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sign-ups', COUNT(*)
  FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'purchases', COUNT(*)
  FROM (/* one row per subscription: its first payment */ SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) AS f
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
)
SELECT e.check_name, e.export_count, b.backend_count,
  CASE WHEN e.export_count = b.backend_count THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM export_counts e
JOIN backend_counts b ON b.check_name = e.check_name

solver.query:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT 'sessions' AS check_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130') AS export_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', session_start), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130') AS backend_count
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'sign-ups',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'sign_up' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signups WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'purchases',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at, arg_min(amount_eur, paid_at) AS first_amount FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) f WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130')
)
SELECT check_name, export_count, backend_count,
  CASE WHEN export_count = backend_count THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM checks
